name: blocko3d
description: The BLOCKO3D build tooling and the b3d command-line tool (check, export, pack/unpack, headless runs, renders). The IDE itself runs as plain files.

scripts.build: esbuild tools/runtime-entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --legal-comments=inline --outfile=runtime/blocko3d.runtime.js && node --no-warnings tools/build-demo.mjs && node --no-warnings tools/build-docs.mjs && node --no-warnings tools/build-ide.mjs
